```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

## Storms Over Time

The following chart displays the number of unique named storms recorded each year in the `storms` dataset.

```{r}
#| label: named-storms-per-year
storms %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_storms = n_distinct(name), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Unique Named Storms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Wind Speed Distribution by Category

The boxplot below shows the distribution of maximum sustained wind speeds for each storm category.

```{r}
#| label: wind-speed-by-category
storms %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(category = as.factor(category)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = wind, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Maximum Sustained Wind Speeds",
    subtitle = "Analysis of wind speeds (knots) across storm categories (1-5)",
    x = "Storm Category",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
